{box:rect(c),top:box('.lc-top'),title:box('.lc-title-wrap'),legs:box('.legs'),wr:box('.lc-wr'), method:box('.lc-method'),summary:box('.lc-method summary'),action:rect(c.querySelector('a')), legsCount:c.querySelectorAll('.legs').length,legCount:c.querySelectorAll('.leg').length, legRows:[...c.querySelectorAll('.leg')].map(n=>({box:rect(n),badge:rect(n.querySelector('.leg-tf')), self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8") self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data))) self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(data); return super().do_GET() def width < 768: assert abs(new["legs"]["width"]-new["top"]["width"]) < 1 assert abs(new["wr"]["width"]-new["top"]["width"]) < 1 assert new["wr"]["y"] >= new["legs"]["bottom"]+15 else: assert abs(new["legs"]["x"]-new["title"]["x"]) < 1 assert new["legs"]["right"]+15 <= new["wr"]["x"] assert abs(new["wr"]["width"]-310) < 1 new["card_height_reduction"] = old["box"]["height"]-new["box"]["height"] new["action_upward"] = (old["action"]["y"]-old["box"]["y"])-(new["action"]["y"]-new["box"]["y"]) if width >= 960 and not stress: assert new["card_height_reduction"] > 60 and new["action_upward"] > 60, new card = page.locator('.lc').first sequence = [card.locator('.lc-since')]+[card.locator('.leg-tf').nth(i) for i in range(card.locator('.leg-tf').count())]+[card.locator('.lc-method summary')] card.locator('.lc-rank').focus() focus = [] for target in sequence: page.keyboard.press('Tab') expect(target).to_be_focused() details = details["visible"] and details["outline"] != "none" and float(details["outlineWidth"].replace('px','')) > 0, details focus.append(details) summary = card.locator('.lc-method summary')
